note: Date & time pickers page, time half (55412:17060): building blocks (hour cell, clock faces, time selector, keyboard field, period selectors), dial pickers (12 / 24 hour, vertical / horizontal) and keyboard pickers. The 24 hour-line variants are stacked on top of each other in their set (no isolated crop): they are covered by the clock faces and the selected hour cell. The horizontal 12-hour dial sits off the pixel grid (x 368.33) and uses an individual export.

hour-sel-enabled.allowedDiffReason: The clock hand's 2px line: the kit draws it from the dial centre + 0.5px past the selector's centre on the 12-hour dial (hour-line building block), but to the cell centre on the 24-hour dial; ours runs centre → selector centre. Only the line's edge pixels differ (Figma vs Chrome line raster).
